note: Copies of this file inside SDK client repos are generated. Edit the canonical path, then copy outward.

frame.description: Flat error frame sent by turn-provider-gateway /sdk (not wrapped in an {error:{...}} envelope).

fields.message: string (TPG's own English sentence for the code; display text only, never branch on it)
fields.requestId: string (optional, echoes the client's requestId on the failed command)
fields.question: string (optional, present for callRejected)

errors.note: The client's own api key was refused, or no auth frame arrived within 10s.

errors.message: The account has no call credit remaining
errors.note: Tell the user to top up. TPG also emits this from its own pre-dial credit check.

errors.message: The account is already using all of its concurrent outbound call lines
errors.note: Wait for one of the account's own calls to end, then issue a new createCall.

errors.message: The callee number is not a verified number for this account
errors.note: Tell the user to verify the number first.

errors.message: No outbound caller number is configured for this account
errors.note: Tell the user to configure an outbound caller number.

errors.message: The call provider rejected this service's credentials
errors.note: Not unauthenticated: these are credentials the client does not hold. Surface as a service fault.

errors.message: The call provider is not accepting new calls
The call provider could not create the media room for this call
The call provider declined to start the call
errors.note: The provider refused and TPG could not classify the refusal. Distinct from internalError: no call was created.
Reserved for faults inside TPG itself.
